lines.cyr: - Кажи, кажи мили сине дали ќе го чуваш
lines.lat: - Kaži, kaži mili sine dali ḱe go čuvaš
lines.en: - Tell me, tell me, dear son, will you look after
your father once he grows old?

lines.cyr: - Ќе те чувам, мили тате, да,
lines.lat: - Ḱe te čuvam, mili tate, da,
lines.en: - I will look after you, dear father, yes,
just as Delchev looked after Macedonia.

lines.cyr: Ти ме створи, порасна, ти ме ожени,
lines.lat: Ti me stvori, porasna, ti me oženi,
lines.en: You gave me life, raised me, and saw me wed,

lines.cyr: ќе те чувам, мили тате, дај боже остари.
lines.lat: ḱe te čuvam, mili tate, daj bože ostari.
lines.en: I will look after you, dear father, may you live to grow old.
Life flows on, passing by so very fast,

lines.cyr: желба имам твои внуци да помилуваш,
lines.lat: želba imam tvoi vnuci da pomiluvaš,
lines.en: I wish for you to caress your grandchildren,
offspring are a source of great joy,
a blessing everyone hopes to see.
A mighty hero, a grandfather’s pride,

lines.cyr: Ти ме створи, порасна, ти ме ожени,
lines.lat: Ti me stvori, porasna, ti me oženi,
lines.en: You gave me life, raised me, and saw me wed,

lines.cyr: ќе те чувам, мили тате, дај боже остари.
lines.lat: ḱe te čuvam, mili tate, daj bože ostari.
lines.en: I will look after you, dear father, may you live to grow old.
